sloka: बहुयोजनसाहस्रं वहमानो महाहरिः ।वायुवच्च मनोवच्च जगाम सह शत्रुणा ।। ७.३४.३० ॥
transliteration: bahuyojanasāhasraṁ vahamāno mahāhariḥ ।vāyuvacca manovacca jagāma saha śatruṇā ।। 7.34.30 ॥

translations.english: The great monkey, carrying his enemy for many thousands of yojanas, traveled with the speed of wind and thought.
